subject: How do i make my function accessible to all chunks

messages.author: 87efd88d1a3f8189
messages.subject: How do i make my function accessible to all chunks
parts:
I have the following code. Watch for the function fx.plotstn. it works if the function is defined  in the chunk but appears not to be globally available. i don't want to copy the function into each chunk. i tried putting it in the setup part of the document but wasn't successful. Any help?

<<setup, include=FALSE, cache=FALSE>>=
library(knitr)
## set global chunk options
opts_chunk$set(fig.path='figure/manual-', cache.path='cache/manual-', fig.align='center', fig.show='hold', par=TRUE,out.width='1\\textwidth')
## I use = but I can replace it with <-; set code/output width to be 68
options(replace.assign=TRUE, width=50)
## tune details of base graphics (http://yihui.name/knitr/hooks)
knit_hooks$set(par=function(before, options, envir){
if (before && options$fig.show!='none') par(mar=c(4,4,.1,.1),cex.lab=.95,cex.axis=.9,mgp=c(2,.7,0),tcl=-.3)
})
library(ggplot2)
library(raster)
library(raster)
library(hydroTSM)
library(zoo)
@

\title{xxxx}

\author{Exx}
\maketitle
\section{NCEP reanalysis Data}
Data are  also downloaded from the NCEP/NCAR Reanalysis 1: Surface Flux dataset. 
http://www.esrl.noaa.gov/psd/data/gridded/data.ncep.reanalysis.surfaceflux.html. The data are Daily precipitation rate in kg/m2/s and are converted at reading to mm. The files downloaded include the following.
<<ListFiles,cache=TRUE,eval=TRUE,echo=TRUE,results='markup',message=FALSE,fig.keep='high'>>=
list.files(pattern="prate")
@

\section{Read NCEP Data}
<<ncep,cache=TRUE,eval=TRUE,echo=TRUE,results='markup',message=FALSE,fig.keep='high'>>=
hydro1<-rbind(Siti,Kakaka,Lubilia)
sp <- SpatialPoints(hydro1)
file<-list.files(pattern="prate.sfc")
for(i in 1:length(file)){
 r<-brick(file[i])
 re<-raster::extract(x=r,sp, method='simple')* 86400
 re<-t(re)
 if(i==1){R<-re}else{R<-rbind(R,re)}
}
date<-rownames(R)
date<-substr(date,2,11)
date<-as.Date(date,format="%Y.%m.%d")

di<-which(!duplicated(date))
Daily<-zoo(R[di,],date[di])
names(Daily)<-rownames(hydro1)
save(Daily, file="Daily.Rdata")
Daily=get(load("Daily.Rdata"))
library(hydroTSM)
Monthly<-daily2monthly(Daily,sum);
Annual<-monthly2annual(Monthly,sum)
plot(Daily,las=2)
plot(Monthly,las=2)
plot(Annual,las=2)
@
\section{Comparing 2011 and 2012 with 1948 - 2010}
\subsection{2011}
<<Siti2011,cache=TRUE,eval=TRUE,echo=TRUE,results='markup',message=FALSE,fig.keep='high'>>=
p2011<-monthlyfunction(window(Monthly,start="2011-01-01",end="2011-12-31"),mean)
p1948to2010<-monthlyfunction(window(Monthly,start="1948-01-01",end="2010-12-31"),mean)
fx.plotstn<-function(stn,lab1,lab2,nam){
 Sums<-round(apply(stn,1,sum),0)
 months<-colnames(stn)
 stn<-data.frame(months,t(stn))
 names(stn)[2:3]<-c(lab1,lab2)
 stn<-melt(stn,id.vars="months")
 ggplot(stn,aes(x=months,y=value,fill=variable))+
 geom_bar(stat="identity",position="dodge")+
 theme_bw()+
 scale_fill_manual(values=c("pink","blue"))+ 
 ggtitle(label=paste(nam,paste(paste(c(lab1,lab2),"[",Sums, "mm]",collapse=" & "))))
}
Siti<-rbind(p2011[1,],p1948to2010[1,])
fx.plotstn(Siti,"2011","1948-2010","Siti") #This is ok.
@
%\pagebreak
<<Kakaka2011,cache=TRUE,eval=TRUE,echo=TRUE,results='markup',message=FALSE,fig.keep='high'>>=
Kakaka<-rbind(p2011[2,],p1948to2010[2,])
fx.plotstn(Kakaka,"2011","1948-2010","Kakaka") #This returns error
@

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] How do i make my function accessible to all chunks
parts:
Hi,

Please see FAQ 1: http://bit.ly/knitr-faq If everything is up-to-date,
please see if the minimal example below works:

%------------------------------
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}

<<test-a, cache=TRUE>>=
f = function(x) x
f(10)
@

<<test-b, cache=TRUE>>=
f(5)
@

\end{document}
%------------------------------

You do not need to redefine a function in every chunk. Objects created
in previous chunks should be available to later chunks.

Regards,
Yihui
--
